models.label: Untuned 14M base
models.about: The pretrained base with no fine-tuning: continues text, does not follow requests on purpose.

models.label: Fine-tuned, exp_006
models.about: First real recipe (v3 data). Learned request wording it had seen; lost on new wording.

models.label: Fine-tuned, exp_007
models.about: More varied wording and requests that must dwell on the asked-for word (v4 data).

models.label: Fine-tuned, exp_008
models.about: exp_007 with length requests sampled three times as often. Did not help.

models.label: Fine-tuned, exp_009
models.about: Adds prominence rules for two-topic requests (v6 data). Best on the training wording for short requests.

models.label: Fine-tuned, exp_011 (longer-pretrained base)
